C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-SEGMENT-252.Summary: Replace the hidden plan lifecycle dropdown with a persistent one-action `Текущие | Архив` segmented control while reusing the existing server-side plan status query.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-SEGMENT-252.Problem: The current plans UI adds lifecycle state as a select inside the general filter grid. A user must discover and open that select to move between active and archived plans, although lifecycle is the primary mutually exclusive view of the register.

Goals.Goal: Show current and archived plan modes permanently in the plans toolbar.
Switch server-side `status=active|archived` with one click, tap or keyboard action.
Preserve current search and ordinary filters while removing stale plan detail when the selected plan is absent in the new result.
Provide accurate mode-specific empty states, 44 pixel targets, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior on desktop and mobile.

Constraints.Constraint: The verified base is exact main commit e6c767949a19a9232e19d95fd8f0632d978f9e69 after terminal archive of C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235.
Issue 252 is the authoritative micro-iteration and issue 236 remains the parent plans repair.
No API, SQLite schema, migration, plan lifecycle, archive/restore command, source-row decision, evidence or document-intake change is included.
The existing hidden select may remain only as an internal compatibility bridge to the current lifecycle module; it is not a second visible state source.
Lifecycle view is never-learn: usage statistics cannot select, reorder or reposition the modes.
No CDN, cloud service, Docker, Internet or LLM dependency is added.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Move the remaining plan filters into a popover or bottom sheet.
Redesign plan cards, detail, source rows or archive impact dialogs.
Implement reversible exclusion of extracted rows.
Change persisted plan status or backend filtering semantics.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `Текущие | Архив` is permanently visible and changes the register with one click, tap, Enter, Space or arrow-key action.
The legacy lifecycle select is hidden from visual and accessibility navigation while retaining compatibility with existing lifecycle operations.
The visible control uses tablist/tab semantics, correct aria-selected state, roving tabindex and a minimum 44 pixel hit area.
The request continues to use the existing server `status=active|archived` parameter; the adapter does not filter an already loaded combined set.
Search and ordinary filters survive the switch; stale detail is cleared or replaced deterministically by the first available plan.
Empty current and archive results have mode-specific text and do not leave previous-plan detail visible.
Desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 have no page-level horizontal overflow; keyboard and reduced-motion flows remain complete.
Focused tests, full project CI and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge, post-merge CI and a separate terminal archive transition.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves one-action lifecycle navigation using the existing server query, with stable responsive geometry, focus and reduced-motion behavior and no data-contract change.

Assumptions.Assumption: The existing lifecycle module remains the authority that appends the selected status to `/api/plans` requests.
The existing plans loader already clears selectedPlanId when the selected plan is absent from the returned status-filtered set.
Archive and restore operations continue to update the internal lifecycle select and refresh the plans view.
